item: A damaged database file is noticed, named and contained per file (E1)
key_paths: src/database/damage.py; src/database/session.py; src/versioned/store.py; src/scheduler/storage_guard.py; src/scheduler/runner.py; src/wiki/runner.py; src/api/scheduler.py; tests/test_database_damage.py
summary: A handle_error observer on the corpus engine and every lane engine reads the driver's SQLITE_CORRUPT code (never a wrong-key 26, never a bound value that says malformed) and latches that file: the corpus latch stops collection admission, maintenance and the housekeeping lanes, a Wikipedia latch stops that lane's loop, a law latch skips the law step, an OSM incident is recorded only. One incident record per (file, scope, statement shape) per process in data/database-damage.json (newest 20, repeats counted, no value, no passphrase) under storage_guard.state(detail=True)['database_damage']; released by the operator starting collection or the lane, never by itself; verify, repair and salvage are E2 and E3.
